assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one production game mascot illustration for Who Got Who. Input image 1 is the approved mascot identity and style reference. Create a single standalone expression variant of EXACTLY this cream fedora with red band and TWO floating cartoon eyes. Preserve the recognizable hat silhouette with its asymmetrical creased crown, curved brim, cream #efe5c6, red #e5484d band, near-black #12100c pupils with small cream highlights. Playful mischievous spy-noir, friendly and cheeky. Bold clean vector-like shapes, minimal soft shading like the reference, strong silhouette, no thin lines. No human face, nose, mouth, body, arms or hands. No text, letters, badges, frames, background panels, drop shadow, glow, watermark, extra characters, or extra eyes. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha, including gaps between the hat and eyes; do not render a checkerboard. Square 1024x1024; the full uncropped mascot centered at consistent scale, about 72% of canvas width, with generous clear margins. Readable at 96px. This is one isolated asset, not a grid or contact sheet. Pose: WAITING / CURIOUS PEEK. Tilt the hat gently clockwise, both eyes wide and inquisitive, both pupils glancing distinctly to the LEFT as if looking out for friends to arrive. One eye slightly higher, eyebrows implied by the hat brim. Friendly anticipation, not nervous or angry. Keep the entire hat and both eyes visible.
